fields.core.title: New Year Wishes beneath Mount Fuji
fields.public_view.description: From beneath Mount Fuji to a simple Happy New Year.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: New Year Wishes beneath Mount Fuji

fields.core.title: Playing on the Beach
fields.public_view.description: The sea breeze was gentle that year, and time had not yet carried the laughter away.

fields.core.title: Zhuhai in the Late 1980s
A Photograph of an Old Postcard Sent from Japan
fields.core.provenance_notes: Purchased from a Harbin second-hand market vendor through Xianyu
fields.public_view.description: A well-preserved old postcard, with a view of Mount Fuji on the front and handwritten text on the reverse.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: View of Mount Fuji
Travel

fields.core.title: A Smile from History
“Hello, Dad” Lasts Longer than Happy New Year
fields.public_view.description: A greeting card from 1993. The wishes are ordinary, but the opening address suddenly gives the paper warmth.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-001/front-publ: New Year greeting card to a father, 1993, back.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-001/back-publi: New Year greeting card to a father, 1993, cover / front.

fields.core.title: No Faraway Places, Only Concern
fields.public_view.description: Family news, and a request to pass on a hello. An old letter makes affection feel as light as everyday life.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-002/front-publ: Letter from a friend with a note about funds, 1993, cover / front.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-002/back-publi: Letter from a friend with a note about funds, 1993, detail.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-002/detail-01-: Letter from a friend with a note about funds, 1993, detail.

fields.core.title: Beyond the Waves, an English Exam Awaits
fields.public_view.description: A notice for a seafarers’ English exam in 1996. Preparing to go to sea includes preparing the vocabulary.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-003/front-publ: Notice of a seafarers’ English competency exam, 1996, cover / front.

fields.core.title: After Retirement, Another Form to Fill
fields.public_view.description: A housing subsidy application form from 2007. The ticks are light; the folds in the paper are heavy.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-LET-004/front-publ: Application to withdraw a housing cash subsidy, 2007, cover / front.

fields.core.title: A Bow Bigger than Any Worry
fields.public_view.description: A small face and a gentle smile. In this black-and-white photograph, childhood has lost none of its brightness.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-006/front-publ: Black-and-white portrait of a young child with a bow, front.

fields.core.title: Stop Posing; This Is Just Right
fields.public_view.description: In a sequence of group photographs, someone raises a camera, someone turns back, and the smiles have not yet been tidied away. The most touching picture is often the least conventional.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-007/front-publ: Sequence of outdoor group portraits beside a railing, front.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-007/back-publi: Sequence of outdoor group portraits beside a railing, detail.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-007/detail-01-: Sequence of outdoor group portraits beside a railing, detail.

fields.core.title: Flowers Hide a Few Words
fields.public_view.description: A bouquet rests beside the face, with a smile behind it. The old photograph is a little reserved, enough to make you look again.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-008/front-publ: Indoor portrait of a woman beside a bouquet, front.

fields.core.title: Walk Slowly along This Road
fields.public_view.description: Tree shadows enclose the road, while the city stays in the distance. The old photograph names no destination, but knows how to make you linger.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-009/front-publ: Tree-lined road with a distant city, front.

fields.core.title: The Second a Face Tilts Up
fields.public_view.description: A child lifts their face; the person beside them smiles. The movement in the photograph is small, but something in the heart moves with it.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-011/front-publ: Adult and young child together on a wooden chair, front.

fields.core.title: The Keys Fall Silent; the Smile Remains
fields.public_view.description: Hands stay on the keys as the gaze turns towards the camera. This silent photograph somehow feels a little like music.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-012/front-publ: Black-and-white portrait beside piano keys, front.

fields.core.title: A Hand Brings the Picture Closer
fields.public_view.description: A monkey reaches out, and a person smiles. The moment beside the rocks feels like a light-hearted joke left by the past.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-013/front-publ: Feeding a monkey beside rocks, front.

fields.core.title: Beyond the Bridge, the Building Remains
fields.public_view.description: A steel bridge and a tall building meet in one old photograph. The road has a past, and the photograph keeps a little warmth.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-014/front-publ: Old photograph of Shanghai Mansions, front.

fields.core.title: Great World, Small Photograph
fields.public_view.description: A tower, a street corner and passers-by all fit into one small old image. The world is vast; the paper that holds it is thin.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-015/front-publ: Old photograph of Shanghai Great World, front.

fields.core.title: The Building at the Corner
fields.public_view.description: The Workers’ Cultural Palace stands at a street corner. Window grids, wires and pedestrians remain clear. The days are distant; the corner is not.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-016/front-publ: Old photograph of the Shanghai Workers’ Cultural Palace, front.

fields.core.title: A Tall Building Holds Up the Past
fields.public_view.description: The Park Hotel stands at the centre of the streetscape. The vehicles are small, the sky is high, and the city’s stature remains.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-017/front-publ: Old photograph of Shanghai’s Park Hotel, front.

fields.core.title: The Riverside Breeze Blows into the Paper
fields.public_view.description: Buildings, vehicles and boats along the Huangpu River line the frame. The black and white is quiet; the riverside was probably lively.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-018/front-publ: Old photograph of the Huangpu riverside, Shanghai, front.

fields.core.title: A Tall Pagoda, a Lightly Passing Day
fields.public_view.description: Someone walks slowly beneath Longhua Pagoda. This photograph lowers the voice of a distant time.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-019/front-publ: Old photograph of Longhua Pagoda, Shanghai, front.

fields.core.title: A Wide Road, a Past Close By
fields.public_view.description: The photograph is titled Shanghai Minhang No. 1 Road. People and vehicles each follow their own directions, while time stops on the same sheet of paper.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-020/front-publ: Old photograph of Minhang No. 1 Road, Shanghai, front.

fields.core.title: The Trees by the Entrance Are Still So Round
fields.public_view.description: The trees before the Children’s Palace are neatly trimmed, and the steps lead inside. The old image is quiet; the imagination is busy.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-021/front-publ: Old photograph of a Children’s Palace, Shanghai, front.

fields.core.title: A Winding Bridge, a Thought Left Unsaid
fields.public_view.description: The Nine-Turn Bridge winds into pavilions and water. There is no dialogue in the photograph; it is a good place to keep words for a while.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-022/front-publ: Old photograph of the Nine-Turn Bridge at Yu Garden, Shanghai, front.

fields.core.title: A Street Corner Stops Time
fields.public_view.description: The Zhongbai Company building, a tram and pedestrians pause together in this old photograph. The city moves on; the image does not.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-023/front-publ: Old photograph of Zhongbai Company, Shanghai, front.

fields.core.title: Just Stand Together
fields.public_view.description: A photograph beside a stone railing, without deliberate poses. What it preserves is simply two people standing together.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-024/front-publ: Two people together beside a stone railing, front.

fields.core.title: A Small World in Someone’s Arms
fields.public_view.description: A wicker chair, a floral dress and a child held close remain in this moment. The longer you look, the softer your heart becomes.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-025/front-publ: Indoor photograph of a person holding a young child, front.

fields.core.title: A Smile in Everyday Life
fields.public_view.description: The furniture, television and standing pose are ordinary. A smile stays with the camera, giving us a reason to look back.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-026/front-publ: Indoor standing portrait with a smile, front.

fields.core.title: The Smile Arrives before the Chopsticks Are Put Down
fields.public_view.description: People gather around a table of food, and the camera catches the meal in progress. Nothing is especially orderly, yet it is especially hard to look away.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-027/front-publ: People eating around a table indoors, front.

fields.core.title: Neat Braids, a Steady Gaze
fields.public_view.description: A small black-and-white portrait preserves the seriousness of childhood. Looking into those eyes, you suddenly feel no hurry to grow up.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-028/front-publ: Black-and-white portrait of a girl with two braids, front.

fields.core.title: Keeping a Little Brightness in the Courtyard
fields.public_view.description: Two people stand beside a sculpture, with branches and leaves in the frame. Old colours hold a moment worth looking at slowly.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-029/front-publ: Two people beside an animal sculpture in a courtyard, front.

fields.core.title: People on Stage, Eyes in the Audience
fields.public_view.description: Two people stand under the lights as a row of spectators watches. The photograph records no sound, but keeps the moment when everyone was together.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-030/front-publ: Two people on a stage, front.

fields.core.title: This Dance Stays in the Photograph
fields.public_view.description: Dance-hall lights are overhead, and two people stand close. The old image has no music, yet the movement asks you to stay another beat.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-031/front-publ: Two people dancing in a dance hall, front.

fields.core.title: This Kiss Stays on Photographic Paper
fields.public_view.description: A wedding dress, formal clothes and gently closed eyes pause in the same instant. The photograph has aged; the closeness remains clear.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-032/front-publ: Studio wedding portrait with a kiss, front.

fields.core.title: Life Was Full When the Glasses Were Raised
fields.public_view.description: The food is still on the table, and the glasses are already raised. The old photograph has no sound, but its liveliness is plain to see.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-033/front-publ: A meal around a round table with raised glasses, front.

fields.core.title: Beauty Kept in the Everyday
fields.public_view.description: A knit top, a few green plants and a standing pose. No grand occasion, yet this photograph rewards another look.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-034/front-publ: Indoor portrait of a woman in a knit top, front.

fields.core.title: The Wind Makes the Treetops Beautiful
fields.public_view.description: Palms, a lawn and a small circular flowerbed remain in the old photograph. Nobody stands in front of them; the scenery has an expression of its own.

fields.core.title: A Little Closer Is Enough
fields.public_view.description: Two people stand close, with a pink wall behind them. The photograph explains no relationship; it simply keeps the moment warm.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-036/front-publ: Two people beside a pink wall, front.

fields.core.title: The Escalator Moves On; the Photograph Stays
fields.public_view.description: A person in red stands in front, with several gazes behind. A group photograph along the way pauses a day in motion for one second.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-037/front-publ: Group portrait on an escalator, front.

fields.core.title: An Outfit with a Mind of Its Own
fields.public_view.description: A hat, glasses and a checked suit; even the collar is carefully arranged. The style in this old photograph would hold its own today.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-038/front-publ: Portrait with a checked suit and hat, front.

fields.core.title: A Vast Sea, a Small Second
fields.public_view.description: Waves reach the person’s side as a hand rises towards the sky. The photograph keeps only an instant, but the openness stays much longer.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PHO-039/front-publ: A hand raised amid the sea waves, front.

fields.core.title: Come and Visit, Will You?
fields.public_view.description: Halfway through the New Year wishes, a gentle invitation appears. Sometimes the most touching words are simply “will you?”
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with a Spring Festival invitation

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-004/front-publ: Postcard with a Spring Festival invitation, back.

fields.core.title: Across the Paths of University, I Still Want to See You
fields.public_view.description: The old card shares studies and everyday news, and hopes for a chance to meet. The future keeps everyone busy, but the greeting is still there.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with university news and hopes of meeting

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-005/front-publ: Postcard with university news and hopes of meeting, back.

fields.core.title: Back Then, a Few Strokes Could Draw a World
fields.public_view.description: Hand-drawn figures, colours and crooked lines remain on a letter-writing festival postcard. There is plenty of earnestness; technique can grow slowly.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Children’s hand-coloured letter-writing festival postcard

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-006/front-publ: Children’s hand-coloured letter-writing festival postcard, front.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-006/back-publi: Children’s hand-coloured letter-writing festival postcard, back.

fields.core.title: Sending Some Longing; Postage Already Paid
fields.public_view.description: The few words on the old postcard are brief. Longing is not explained at length, but it has already reached the paper.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard sending longing and good wishes

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-012/front-publ: Postcard sending longing and good wishes, back.

fields.core.title: Long Time No See; Visit in the Winter Break
fields.public_view.description: News, studies, and an invitation to meet during the holidays. One invitation shortens the distance on a postcard.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard to a former classmate with a winter-break invitation

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-014/front-publ: Postcard to a former classmate with a winter-break invitation, back.

fields.core.title: The Reply Is Late; the Concern Remains
fields.public_view.description: A few lines begin with an apology, ask for news, then invite a visit when there is time. Awkward earnestness can be touching too.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard apologizing for a late reply and inviting a visit

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-015/front-publ: Postcard apologizing for a late reply and inviting a visit, back.

fields.core.title: The Gathering Is Over; Let Us Meet Again
fields.public_view.description: The handwriting recalls a gathering and invites another visit during the festival. When the crowd disperses, the greetings continue.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postal postcard recalling a theatre-group gathering and a Spring Festival invitation

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-016/front-publ: Postal postcard recalling a theatre-group gathering and a Spring Festival invitation, back.

fields.core.title: A Quiet River, a Slightly Impatient Letter
fields.public_view.description: The Li River is on the front; the back asks whether a letter has arrived. The landscape moves slowly, but concern cannot quite wait.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Li River cormorant postcard

fields.core.title: The Bike Stays on Paper; the Wishes Are on Their Way
fields.public_view.description: A Suzuki motorcycle on the front, a few good wishes on the reverse. The machine is hard; the kindness sent with it is soft.

fields.core.title: Cats Know How to Sleep; Words Know How to Warm
fields.public_view.description: A Cat Island collage on the front, words of thanks for companionship on the back. The cute exterior holds something sincere.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Cat Island collage postcard with words on companionship

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-020/front-publ: Cat Island collage postcard with words on companionship, front.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-020/back-publi: Cat Island collage postcard with words on companionship, back.

fields.core.title: Keep Trying; I Am with You in These Words
fields.public_view.description: Handwritten words about aspirations and effort settle on a postcard. Behind the encouragement is a deep care for friendship.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with words on effort and friendship

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-022/front-publ: Postcard with words on effort and friendship, back.

fields.core.title: Ordinary Can Still Be Earnest
fields.public_view.description: New Year thoughts on the back of a postcard. The writer calls themself ordinary, but refuses to live carelessly.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with New Year words about ordinary people avoiding a mediocre life

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-023/front-publ: Postcard with New Year words about ordinary people avoiding a mediocre life, back.

fields.core.title: Busy with Exams, Still Thinking of You
fields.public_view.description: The writing is dense and the news plentiful. Amid the end-of-term rush, there is still room for a seasonal greeting.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with end-of-term news and Christmas wishes

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-024/front-publ: Postcard with end-of-term news and Christmas wishes, back.

fields.core.title: The Language Changes; the Concern Does Not
fields.public_view.description: An envelope and two pages of handwritten Japanese share one scan. The strokes differ; the earnestness is the same.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Handwritten Japanese letter and envelope, 4 October 1997

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-027/front-publ: Handwritten Japanese letter and envelope, 4 October 1997, front.

fields.core.title: May You Be Well, and at Ease
fields.public_view.description: An old postcard brings New Year wishes together with words about inner qualities. A few lines preserve a moment of earnest reassurance.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: New Year postcard with words on appearance and inner qualities

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-028/front-publ: New Year postcard with words on appearance and inner qualities, back.

fields.core.title: Writing Trees into a Letter
fields.public_view.description: A few reflections remain on the reverse of a postcard. Trees, paintings and faraway places meet on one sheet of paper.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with reflections on trees and faraway places

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-031/front-publ: Postcard with reflections on trees and faraway places, back.

fields.core.title: Borrow a Sea to Send a Few Good Wishes
fields.public_view.description: A beach on the front, seasonal greetings on the reverse. The scenery is far away; the handwritten lines feel close.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Waikiki Beach postcard with seasonal greetings

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-034/front-publ: Waikiki Beach postcard with seasonal greetings, front.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-034/back-publi: Waikiki Beach postcard with seasonal greetings, back.

fields.core.title: Keep a Little Warmth with You
fields.public_view.description: The wishes on this old postcard are direct. The paper fits in a pocket, and the affection wants to travel with you.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with wishes to keep close

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-035/front-publ: Postcard with wishes to keep close, back.

fields.core.title: Turn the Room Over, and Find a Greeting
fields.public_view.description: A blue bottle, delicate flowers and small ornaments on the front; English Christmas wishes on the back. A private corner can become a kindness sent away.

fields.core.title: It Is All Right to Be Afraid; You Can Still Go Forward
fields.public_view.description: The words on this old card speak of courage and confidence. The handwriting feels like someone behind you offering a gentle hand.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Card encouraging self-belief and taking a chance

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-040/front-publ: Card encouraging self-belief and taking a chance, back.

fields.core.title: A Greeting Wants to Knock on Your Window
fields.public_view.description: A few handwritten lines compare New Year wishes to a knock at the window. The sound is small; the intention is clear.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: New Year postcard with a window-of-the-heart greeting

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-041/front-publ: New Year postcard with a window-of-the-heart greeting, back.

fields.core.title: Do Not Cry; I Will Be with You Next Year Too
fields.public_view.description: A little bear and “don’t cry” stickers sit beside the New Year wishes. The card says little, but already feels like a gentle embrace.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with New Year wishes and don’t-cry stickers

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-042/front-publ: Postcard with New Year wishes and don’t-cry stickers, back.

fields.core.title: Yellow Flowers Say Happy New Year for Someone
fields.public_view.description: Yaohuang peonies stand in a vase, with Chinese and English New Year wishes on the reverse. The greeting is modest; the colour is already warm enough.

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-043/front-publ: Yaohuang peony postcard with New Year wishes, front.
image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-043/back-publi: Yaohuang peony postcard with New Year wishes, back.

fields.core.title: Another Year; How about You?
fields.public_view.description: The old postcard first gives the writer’s news, then sends a question to someone far away. Wanting to know how you are remains a serious matter.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with news from Yichang and New Year greetings

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-044/front-publ: Postcard with news from Yichang and New Year greetings, back.

fields.core.title: Even Technical Questions Are Written with Care
fields.public_view.description: A postal postcard is densely covered with questions about communications and mobile phones. The interest is specific, and the writing committed.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postal postcard asking about mobile communications technology

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-045/front-publ: Postal postcard asking about mobile communications technology, back.

fields.core.title: A Small Card Can Ask a Serious Question
fields.public_view.description: An old postcard carries an inquiry about postal reference material. The more specific the interest, the more careful the writing.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard asking about a postal money-order reference guide

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-046/front-publ: Postcard asking about a postal money-order reference guide, back.

fields.core.title: Good Wishes Include Your Family Too
fields.public_view.description: A few vertical lines of greeting keep both a friend and their family in mind. The postcard is small; the concern is generous.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with New Year’s Day wishes for the recipient and family

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-048/front-publ: Postcard with New Year’s Day wishes for the recipient and family, back.

fields.core.title: Turning Plans into Reality, Little by Little
fields.public_view.description: The old postcard asks for news, then turns to the coming year. Its wishes do not float in the sky; they settle into everyday life.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard wishing for plans to become reality in the new year

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-050/front-publ: Postcard wishing for plans to become reality in the new year, back.

fields.core.title: Do Well in Your Studies, and Come to Visit
fields.public_view.description: The old card wishes success in studies and invites a meeting. Earnestness and closeness share the same space.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard wishing for progress in studies and inviting a home visit

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-051/front-publ: Postcard wishing for progress in studies and inviting a home visit, back.

fields.core.title: When the Wind Comes, Count It as My Greeting
fields.public_view.description: An old greeting card sends faraway wishes through the image of wind chimes. The words are light; the concern is not.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard sending wishes through the image of distant wind chimes

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-052/front-publ: Postcard sending wishes through the image of distant wind chimes, back.

fields.core.title: How Have You Been Lately?
fields.public_view.description: A handwritten greeting carries the closeness of everyday speech. The postcard is small, just large enough for a familiar voice.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Postcard with Cantonese news and Christmas wishes

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-054/front-publ: Postcard with Cantonese news and Christmas wishes, back.

fields.core.title: It Is Beautiful Here; Only You Are Missing
fields.public_view.description: The postcard contains only a brief invitation. Even the loveliest place can make you wish to call someone over.
fields.metadata.dimensions.PC12.image_subject: Air-mail-border postcard saying this place is beautiful and inviting a quick visit

image_descriptions./archive/LJM-20261011-PST-056/front-publ: Air-mail-border postcard saying this place is beautiful and inviting a quick visit, back.
